subject: Alder Bio — Ops onboarding sprint & comms plan
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: Clayton Rivera <clayton.rivera@alderbio.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Jun 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Alder Bio — ops onboarding sprint & comms plan

Hi team — putting the Alder Bio handoff in your inbox. Clayton and I closed the commercial terms yesterday (deal ID ALD-2029-042). Key context below and two asks: CSA owner assignment + confirmation of kickoff date.

Quick context: Alder Bio will start with a Dedicated cluster (NVIDIA H100), Private control plane in us-west-2, and require VPC peering and customer-managed KMS. They estimate ~120M tokens/month growth over 6 months; initial pilot targets 5k reqs/day. Primary success metric: stable 95th perc latency < 200ms for internal inference routes; secondary: integration with their SSO (SAML) and ingestion connector.

Important contract bits (call out for CS/Cloud):
- 90-day pilot / 12-month commitment thereafter (pricing agreed).
- Data residency: us-west only.
- SOC 2 evidence requested; procurement will need certs and an org-level contact.
- DocuSign for SOW (attached draft).

Attachments: ALD-2029-MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOW-draft-ALD.pdf (draft).

Asks (please):
1) Assign primary CS owner and escalation lead for first 90 days.
2) Confirm availability for kickoff week of 2029-06-17 — preference Tue/Wed mornings PT.
3) Call out any infra pre-reqs we need to request from Alder (VPC CIDR, firewall rules, KMS ARN, SSO metadata).

Clayton, adding you here so the CS team has direct contact.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart | Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the context, Evelyn — and congrats on getting this over the line. Quick internal notes and proposed owners: 

Owners (proposed):
- Primary CS: Karthik Iyer (hand-off lead / customer success manager)
- Technical implementation lead: Mina Haddad (solutions engineer)
- Cloud/infra contact: Dev Patel (private deployment engineer)
- Executive sponsor (Sales): Evelyn Hart

Pre-req checklist for kickoff (please validate):
- Procurement: SOC 2 report bundle + security questionnaire answered (Evelyn: can you confirm which doc set procurement needs?)
- Networking: VPC CIDR, peering contact, and allowlist for our edge IPs
- Security: KMS ARN and whether customer requires HSM-backed keys
- Auth: SAML metadata + test user for SSO validation
- Data/ingest: sample payload and expected traffic profile for the pilot

Timeline proposal:
- Kickoff: Tue 2029-06-18 09:00 PT — 60-90m (technical intake + roles/comms)
- Sprint 0 (2 weeks): infra provision, network peering, SSO smoke test, deploy pilot variant
- Pilot period: 30d with weekly checkpoints; canary traffic + rollback SLOs defined in MAP

Risks to call out: quantization/profile expectations — 120M tokens/mo will need quantization plan + batching to keep costs within the pricing we agreed; Mina, please confirm model variant and expected perf tradeoffs for the pilot.

Next steps: Evelyn, please confirm kickoff time and share procurement contact. Clayton, can procurement/IT join the kickoff?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior CSM, Redwood Inference

- SSO: We'll send SAML metadata + a test user by EOD 6/11.
- KMS: We use AWS KMS with a customer-managed key (ARN below), HSM not required for this environment. KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
- Network: VPC CIDR is 10.18.0.0/16; peering request queued with our cloud team.

We expect to route internal-only inference (no PHI) in pilot — mostly batch scoring from internal pipelines (S3 -> Redwood).

Clayton

Thanks — noted. Technical checklist (Mina notes) with action owners: 

- Model variant & perf: I'll validate recommended variant (redwood-llama-70b-q4 + perf profile) and attach perf baseline by 6/12. OWNER: Mina.
- Quantization/Batching config: propose initial batch window = 50ms, dynamic batching up to 8 tokens/request; will tune during pilot. OWNER: Mina.
- Infra provisioning: Dev to request private control plane environment and confirm peering steps. OWNER: Dev Patel.
- Secrets/KMS integration: Dev to confirm KMS IAM role mapping and whether customer wants key rotation cadence. OWNER: Dev Patel.
- Smoke tests: create small sanity set from Alder sample payloads (Clayton to provide). OWNER: Mina + Alder engineer on kickoff.

I'll put together a one-page runbook for the kickoff (network steps, SSO quick test, rollback plan) and share before Tue.

—Mina
